title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu and Bunny | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu the little duck and Bunny on a sunny river! Shiny bubbles float up and pop on every "merrily", Bunny dreams of carrots, a little blue bird flies down to ride in the boat, and a rainbow grows across the sky.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1852).
